dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Good morning. Please tell me what has been bothering you and when the symptoms started.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I have had a very sore throat and a fever for about three days. Swallowing is uncomfortable, especially in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you also had a cough, shortness of breath, or any pain in your chest?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No, I have not been coughing and I do not have any chest pain or trouble breathing.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you taken anything for the fever or throat pain since this started?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I took paracetamol yesterday evening and again this morning. It helped the fever for a few hours but my throat still hurts.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Do you have any known allergies to medicines, food, or anything else?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. I do not have any known allergies.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: All right. Keep drinking plenty of fluids and continue monitoring the fever. We will examine your throat and decide whether any additional treatment is needed.
